# Bayshore Health

> Bayshore Health is a healthcare BD and revenue advisory based in Tampa, FL. Two operators — Adam Teitelman and Mike Maseda — help healthcare companies from seed to Series C build sales motions, close enterprise deals, and fix revenue operations. No associates; engagements are capped at two at a time.

Bayshore is exclusively healthcare. The team brings fifteen years of buyer-side experience across IDNs, health plans, post-acute, value-based care, and AI-native digital health.

## Practices

- Sales strategy & execution: full GTM rebuilds for companies where founder-led sales hit a ceiling
- Fractional BD & healthcare GTM advisory: monthly retainers, 12-month minimum, travel included
- Deal sprint / close support: flat fee plus a capped closed-won kicker on signed deals
- RevOps & RevTech: CRM, forecast models, and pipeline reporting that boards trust
- AI-native GTM design: GTM architecture for AI and agentic healthcare products

## Who it's for

- Seed through Series C healthcare companies; heaviest at Series A and B
- Software, AI/agentic platforms, virtual care, care-in-the-home, clinical workforce, employer benefits, and VBC contracting infrastructure
- Pre-revenue teams fit project-based GTM advisory; teams with a VP Sales fit project work that runs alongside, not over

## How engagements work

- First call: 30 minutes, no deck, ends in a clear yes or no on fit
- NDA available before the diagnostic call; references from three founders on request
- Diagnostics kick off within two weeks of contract; embedded rebuilds ramp in 3–4 weeks
- Every engagement has 3–5 written success metrics pulled from the client's system of record
- 30-day no-questions-asked exit on every engagement
- Pricing: fixed-fee projects; monthly fractional retainers; deal sprints flat fee plus kicker

## Articles

- [How much does fractional healthcare BD cost?](https://www.bayshore.health/fractional-healthcare-bd-cost.html): fixed-fee projects, 12-month retainers, deal sprints with a capped closed-won kicker; pricing tracks to one VP Sales hire
- [VP Sales or fractional BD?](https://www.bayshore.health/vp-sales-vs-fractional-bd.html): hire a VP to scale a repeatable motion; use fractional BD to design one
- [Inside a healthcare GTM diagnostic](https://www.bayshore.health/healthcare-gtm-diagnostic.html): the 30-minute call, week-zero metrics, and the written handoff
